recipe.visualDefinition: A central photographic portrait of a man framed by an ornate, symmetrical psychedelic border featuring vibrant concentric waves, floral patterns, and a central butterfly crest.
coreVisualRelationships: The photographic subject is contained within a curvilinear, organic frame.
The top header area balances two distinct text blocks flanking a central butterfly.
Concentric color bands create a sense of depth and vibration around the portrait.
The bottom section features mirrored landscape elements with stylized trees and rainbows.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale photographic portrait centered in the middle two-thirds of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central butterfly at the top and the symmetrical trees at the bottom anchor the vertical axis.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top text, follows the curving border down around the face, and rests on the bottom landscape details.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with patterns and illustrative elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Magenta and Cyan provide the primary psychedelic vibration in the border.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep browns and greens in the landscape and hair provide a grounded contrast to the neon border.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow and orange used for highlights in the butterfly and sun motifs.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the graphic border against a more naturalistic, slightly desaturated photographic center.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid modern digital gradients; use flat, opaque color fields typical of gouache.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold sans-serif with extreme swelling and rounded terminals.
letterConstructionRules: Letters must follow the curve of the containing graphic shape.
Variable stroke width with heavy bottom-weighting.
Tight, overlapping kerning where glyphs touch or nestle.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Counters are minimized to small dots or slits.

composition.position: Top left and top right quadrants

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: The custom bubble lettering is paired with a small, condensed sans-serif in the corner for technical metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the authentic 1960s psychedelic poster aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man with a 1960s haircut, framed by a symmetrical, multi-colored psychedelic border featuring flowers, a butterfly at the top, and two stylized trees at the bottom. Leave the top floral panels blank for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply hand-drawn, white bubble-style lettering into the top left and right floral panels, following the upward curve of the frame.

verificationChecks: Is the lettering following the curve of the frame?
Are the colors in the border high-contrast and vibrating?
Is the symmetry maintained across the vertical axis?

adjustableVariables: Width of the concentric color bands
mustRedesign: The specific photographic likeness of the individual

mustAchieve: Hand-painted gouache texture in the border

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible despite the heavy distortion.
Check that the photographic center blends naturally with the illustrated border.
Verify the presence of the rainbow motifs in the bottom corners.
Confirm the border is perfectly symmetrical.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central portrait + Symmetrical psychedelic border + Bubble lettering on curved paths + Floral/Nature motifs.
